name: Photo chapters
look: Each step depends on the last and shows a distinct result. For independent details use a compact list or captioned views side by side.
reduced: Nothing is pinned: the chapters stand side by side, each photograph over its title and lines, and the section is as tall as they are.
phone: Each photograph flows above its title and description.

needs.words: Three or four chapters, each with a title and two lines.
needs.pictures: one photograph per chapter, all of one place, product or job, none used elsewhere on the page

height: Desktop holds half a screen per chapter plus the stage. Phone chapters take their natural height.
